searchText: I've used that book to implement my own so if you have questions feel free. See: - sage code to derive the endomorphisms constants https://github.com/mratsim/constantine/blob/master/sage/derive_endomorphisms.sage - A bit more clear, the lattice decomposition finder without all the fluff surrounding code https://github.com/mratsim/constantine/commit/ac37b55aa134f8adacc4df306dc905e11875af86 (deleted, replaced by something generic) - Lattice decomposition for BLS12-381 https://github.com/mratsim/constantine/blob/ac37b55/sage/lattice_decomposition_bls12_381_g1.sage (deleted later once working) One pitfall that made me lose time. endomorphism acceleration only works on points in the correct subgroup, so don't forget to clear the cofactor when testing. also I don't remember which one, but one of the lattice they gave for BLS was incorrect hence why I derived my own. Appendix A of this paper https://eprint.iacr.org/2014/401.pdf was also very helpful
